issues.where: field behind the plant, both sides and middle distance
issues.what: background plants are in sharp focus and render as near-black flat silhouettes with hard edges; in -a they are soft, heavily defocused and veiled in blue-grey fog, so the shallow depth of field and separation of the hero plant are lost
issues.fix: put the background well out of focus (wide-aperture bokeh matching -a), lift the blacks and wash the field with fog so it sits behind the hero plant

issues.where: air between the hero plant and the far field
issues.what: aerial perspective is wrong: near-background plants are dark and contrasty, then the field jumps to a pale grey band at the horizon; -a has a smooth, gradual falloff into dense fog with no visible horizon line
issues.fix: add depth-graded fog density so plants fade progressively with distance and the skyline dissolves into the fog

issues.what: leaf arrangement and shape differ: -a has narrow pointed lance leaves angled upward in pairs with a big frosted leaf lower left and right; -b has broad heart-shaped flat leaves held horizontally, a large leaf covering the lower stem, and different positions, so it does not read as the same plant
issues.fix: rebuild the leaves as narrower, pointed, upward-angled leaves at the same nodes and positions as -a

issues.what: frost on leaf edges is a thick, uniform white fringe that looks like an outline or cutout halo, hanging below the leaf; -a has fine crystalline frost needles along the edge and a granular frost dusting across the leaf surface
issues.fix: replace the edge fringe with fine sparse ice crystals and add frost speckle across the upper leaf surface

issues.what: bud is darker and flatter in tone, with bracts reading near-black and outlined by a hard white rim; -a bud is mid green with visible tonal modeling, rim light from the backlit sun, and frost tips on bract points
issues.fix: lift the bud midtones toward -a green, soften the white edge outline into backlit rim light and frost tips

issues.what: -b is colder and more neutral grey with crushed blacks in foliage; -a has a soft teal-green foliage cast with raised, milky blacks from the fog
issues.fix: raise black level, add the teal-green cast to the foliage and reduce overall contrast to match -a

issues.what: sun disc is larger and harder-edged with a weaker warm halo; -a sun is smaller, diffused by fog, with a broad warm pink-orange glow around it
issues.fix: shrink and soften the sun disc and widen the warm halo glow

issues.what: stem hairs are fine and dense but lack the backlit frosty sparkle of -a; stem is slightly thicker and straighter
issues.fix: add backlit frost glints to the stem hairs

issues.what: sky is slightly cooler and bluer grey with less fog texture than -a's warmer milky grey
issues.fix: warm the sky slightly and add subtle fog variation
